description: Read one ASN's evidence for a site: the current tier and reason (judged on yesterday + today), plus a 7, 30 or 90 day history with per-day requests and distinct URLs, the status distribution (2xx/3xx/4xx/5xx/unknown), the top normalized paths, the UA pool and its automation share, the cross-ASN group the ASN shares a signature with, the ignore flag, and the per-ASN Cloudflare/nginx/app block-rule text when it is A-tier. An ASN with history but no current tier still returns its days; an ASN with no rows in the chosen history window is not found. Evidence only: this tool never blocks or ignores traffic, and a tier is not a block decision. Requires the audit:read scope.

historyDays.description: History window for daily rows, top paths and UA pool; the tier is always judged on yesterday + today

name: get_asn_detail
title: One ASN's traffic evidence in depth
